conviction_note: This is close to a non-result. The reported quarter hardly matters: REVTORPYK became commercially available only on 2026-09-30 (8-K), so Q3 revenue is near zero against a disputed bar. The stock will trade on the first commercial colour for Q4, and I found no independent demand series for it (IV buy-and-bill drug, no public script data). Against that, the bar is already low after a 41% fall from 96.43 on 2026-09-03 to 56.58 on 2026-10-16, calls are bid (skew -16.7), short interest is 21% of shares outstanding, and EPS estimates were cut in the last 7 days. So p_up is 52 on abs_move 11, the option-implied 11.19% (indicative, ATM spread 41% of mid), which is far above this name's pre-launch median of 3.1% because the line is new. impact_sum +0.6 and impact_scaled +0.44 roughly agree.
bar: Disputed. Q3 2026 revenue: Yahoo $0.517M avg of 10 analysts (low blank/zero, high $4.17M) at https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CELC/analysis/ (read 2026-11-05), against $1.56-1.7M from FXEmpire and Benzinga (likely stale; via search). Q3 EPS -1.53 (2 analysts, Yahoo; -1.46 FXEmpire). The bar that probably decides the reaction is Q4 2026 revenue at $20.09M avg of 11 analysts (range $6.5M-$53.7M) and FY2027 $296.2M (range $120M-$594M), from Yahoo only. No company revenue guidance exists (Q2 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603454/000119312526349227/celc-ex99_1.htm). Every size here is capped small because the bar has one source or two that disagree.
positioning_check: Short interest 10,252,223 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 21.0% of 48.93M shares outstanding, 5.76 days to cover. It was 10,979,648 / 11.03 days on 2026-09-30 and 11,360,367 / 12.48 days on 2026-09-15; Equibles models the 2026-10-30 settlement at about 10.87M (https://equibles.com/stocks/celc/shortinterest, read 2026-11-05; also https://massive.com/quote/celc). As a share of float it is higher, because Baker Bros hold a large block (Julian Baker sold $291M at $102.50, filed 2026-07-16). Part of the short is probably a hedge against $575M of 0.25% 2032 converts (conversion price $124.53, so delta is low at $65) and against the older notes, which makes it less squeeze-prone than the headline suggests. Skew is -16.74 vol points (calls over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.78. The tape: -55.5% from the 52-week high, 20-day -4.95%, 5-day -6.91%, and -6.5% intraday today (69.24 to 64.71) with no news found.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-30 8-K says REVTORPYK became 'commercially available' that day, after supply waited on FDA sign-off of a second manufacturing site. So Q3 2026 holds at most a day or two of initial stocking: Q3 product revenue is near zero against a disputed bar of $0.52M (Yahoo, 10 analysts) or $1.56-1.7M (FXEmpire/Benzinga), and Q3 opex stays near Q2's $66.1M (Q3 EPS bar -1.53).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior revenue print. The last seven prints were pre-commercial and moved a median 3.13% (max 8.11%). On 2026-07-15 the stock fell 17.6% on news that launch timing was later than expected, so this name punishes timing slippage.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced. The Yahoo average has already fallen to $0.52M, which suggests most analysts model about zero. The two higher aggregator figures may still anchor screens that report a 'miss' headline. If the market had fully priced near-zero Q3 revenue, no source would still carry $1.6M.
findings.independence: The Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603454/000119312526349227/celc-ex99_1.htm) guided shipments to 'late Q3 2026', and Fierce Pharma reported that the second-site sign-off was gating (https://www.fiercepharma.com/pharma/celcuity-keeps-cool-amid-questions-about-revtorpyk-launch-timing, via search).

findings.finding: Analysts cut estimates in the 7 days before the print. Yahoo shows 2 down-revisions and 0 up for Q3, Q4 and FY2026. Q4 EPS went from -0.82 to -0.93, FY2026 from -4.39 to -4.52, and FY2027 from -0.08 to -0.49 (90 days ago +0.96). The cut to 2027 is consistent with a lower revenue ramp, about $20M less net income. The Q4 revenue bar is $20.1M on a range of $6.5-53.7M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: the company has never given revenue guidance, and this is its first commercial quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The revisions are a week old and the stock fell 6.5% today. But the published Q4 range is still 8x wide, so the first commercial colour (October patients, ordering accounts, Q4 tone) will move the bar either way. Two readings: analysts lowered launch curves after checks (negative), or the cuts lower the bar the print has to clear (positive). This is a proxy, not a company number.
findings.independence: Zacks listed CELC as a 'Strong Sell' on 2026-10-14, which is also estimate-revision driven (Yahoo news list, https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/quote/CELC/). It is the same underlying revisions, so not independent.

findings.finding: Positioning is set up for a low bar. The stock fell 41% from 96.43 (2026-09-03) to 56.58 (2026-10-16) through the launch with no company-specific negative document found. It now sits at 64.5, -55.5% from the high. Short interest is 10.25M shares (21% of shares outstanding, 5.8 days to cover, 2026-10-15), and the option market pays for upside (25-delta skew -16.74).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-10-22 a Cantor initiation ($140 target) moved the stock +7.8% intraday, so the name does lift sharply on supportive news from a depressed base. After the 2026-08-13 Q2 print it moved +6.24%.
findings.why_not_priced: The short and the drawdown are public, and the skew already leans up, so this is in the price as a lean. What is not settled is whether a non-disastrous first commercial update forces covering. Some of the short is convert hedges, which do not cover on news.
findings.independence: Price path: Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/CELC?range=6mo&interval=1d). Skew: sealed baseline. Different sources, but all market data, not company evidence.

findings.finding: Access groundwork is already in place before Q4 demand. NCCN listed gedatolisib + fulvestrant ± palbociclib as a preferred Category 1 second-line regimen (version 6.2026, 2026-07-29), 16 days after approval. Payer policies exist (Ambetter CP.PHAR.808 dated 07.21.26; a CVS Caremark PA form). The company runs 88 oncology specialists covering about 9,000 providers, and WAC is $10,000 per vial, about $30,000 per 28-day cycle, so each patient is worth about $360k a year at list price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The NCCN listing on 2026-07-30 came while the stock was around 87, and it did not reverse the post-approval drop. The market has not paid for access news on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: The facts are known. What is not priced is how fast they turn into Q4 patients at about $30k a cycle: a few hundred patients in Q4 would already clear the $20M consensus. If this were priced, the Q4 estimate range would not run from $6.5M to $53.7M.

findings.finding: The sNDA for the PIK3CA-mutant indication went in on 2026-08-26 (HR 0.50 triplet / 0.51 doublet vs alpelisib). As of 2026-11-05 (day 71) no press release or 8-K announces FDA acceptance, review classification or a PDUFA date, although the company press-released the original NDA's priority-review acceptance. The day-60 filing decision has passed and the day-74 letter is due about 2026-11-08, so the Q3 release or call is likely to disclose the classification.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the original NDA got priority review and a 2026-07-17 PDUFA date, the stock gained (https://rallies.ai/news/celcuity-gains-as-fda-sets-july-17-2026-gedatolisib-priority-review-decision-date). Label expansion to the mutant population (about 40% of 2L HR+/HER2-) is the second leg of every peak-sales model.
findings.why_not_priced: It is not yet disclosed. Priority review would put a PDUFA date around late February 2027 under RTOR; standard review would push it to about June 2027. The sign depends on which, and I lean slightly to priority given the original NDA's treatment and the active-comparator win.
findings.independence: EDGAR filing list shows no 8-K since 2026-10-02 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001603454&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40). The Citi conference summary says approval of the mutant indication is anticipated 'in the second quarter' (year unclear), https://quartr.com/events/celcuity-inc-celc-citigroup-s-biopharma-back-to-school-summit-2026_oqufg2jk.

findings.finding: Supply was the gating factor: the Q2 call said shipments needed FDA sign-off on a second manufacturing site, and in September the company said it plans four validated manufacturers by 2027. Commercial availability on 2026-09-30 implies the gate cleared, but no document confirms Q4 supply is unconstrained. The call will be the first statement on whether supply limits Q4 patient starts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The supply-linked launch delay cost 17.6% on 2026-07-15.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a tail risk, not a base case: launch happened on schedule. If the market feared continuing constraint, the skew would not lean to calls.
findings.independence: The Fierce Pharma report on second-site gating (via search, 2026-07) is the same topic from an earlier date, not independent confirmation.

findings.finding: At ESMO 2026 (2026-10-24, LBA16) Celcuity presented updated PIK3CA-mutant cohort data. One subgroup reported triplet median PFS of 21.5 months vs 9.1 for alpelisib in patients without liver metastases (HR 0.47 triplet, 0.38 doublet). It also showed mCRPC Phase 1b/2 data (2026-10-23) and a network meta-analysis vs other 2L regimens (Tolaney). The call is the first place management can tie this to the sNDA and to promotion.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close went from 65.25 (2026-10-23) to 65.80 (2026-10-26), so the data was taken flat. The June ASCO mutant data cost 22% on 'lofty' expectations.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. It was public 12 days ago and the stock was flat afterwards. Only management's framing on the call is new.
findings.independence: The ESMO schedule release of 2026-10-05 (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/CELC/celcuity-esmo-congress-2026-presentations) is the same company source.

outside_window.finding: The PDUFA decision on the PIK3CA-mutant sNDA (submitted 2026-08-26) lands in roughly Q1-Q2 2027.
The official FINRA short-interest figure for the 2026-10-30 settlement is due 2026-11-10, after the exit.

A cause for the 41% Sep-Oct drawdown and for today's -6.5%: no 8-K, no company news and no peer event found.

Financing: cash $754M at 2026-06-30 with runway 'at least into 2029'. No new ATM, S-3 or debt 8-K since June, so no financing finding.
Insider Form 4s since August: only a director's 250-share option exercise at $7.60 on 2026-10-07, which carries no information.

baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the skew (calls bid) and with the depressed run-up: a low bar and a crowded short point mildly up. I found no document that says the launch is beating, so the lean stays small. Today's unexplained -6.5% and the 7-day estimate cuts are the counterweight.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0) and lesson 7 (a crowded short is a mechanism): the positioning finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.5, keeping only the short-interest and skew part.
Lesson 6 (the bar has one source or two that disagree): all findings stay capped small. The estimate-revision finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.3; it rests on Yahoo alone.
Lesson 7 (shrink negatives against a 21% short): the supply-risk finding was cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
Lesson 8 and the core (the hunters understate moves): abs_move_pct was raised from 10 to 11, the option-implied move, rather than the pre-launch history median of 3.1.
Lessons 1 and 2 left the NCCN, ESMO and sNDA items standing at their small sizes.
